I'm Xijun Wei, a student taking ETC5523: Communicating with Data at Monash University. In this blog, I explore how research can be explained clearly to readers without a technical background. My current topic is COVID-19 border quarantine: how vaccine protection, viral transmission and community vaccination influence risk. Through this project, I am practising turning a technical report into an accessible data story, using plain language and focused visuals to connect research findings with the questions readers care about.
